# nlohmann/json

Vendored single-header dependency for strict SKRV manifest parsing.

- Version: 3.12.0
- Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
- License: MIT
- Expected `json.hpp` SHA-256: `AAF127C04CB31C406E5B04A63F1AE89369FCCDE6D8FA7CDDA1ED4F32DFC5DE63`

The header and license are copied unmodified from the upstream `v3.12.0`
release/tag. SKRTG code includes it privately; it is not exposed in the SKRV
public API.
